changeSet.sql: DO $do$ DECLARE r record; v_person bigint; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT au.fk_institution_id AS institution_id, regexp_replace(trim(au.scientific_manager), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS raw FROM public.action_unit au WHERE nullif(trim(au.scientific_manager), '') IS NOT NULL AND au.fk_scientific_manager_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LOOP v_person := public.tmp_siamois_person_for_name(r.raw, false, r.institution_id); UPDATE public.action_unit au SET fk_scientific_manager_id = v_person WHERE au.fk_institution_id = r.institution_id AND regexp_replace(trim(au.scientific_manager), '\s+', ' ', 'g') = r.raw; PERFORM public.tmp_siamois_add_awaiting_member(v_person, r.institution_id, au.action_unit_id) FROM public.action_unit au WHERE au.fk_scientific_manager_id = v_person AND au.fk_institution_id = r.institution_id; END LOOP; END $do$;

changeSet.author: Julien Linget
changeSet.sql: DO $do$ DECLARE r record; v_person bigint; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT s.fk_institution_id AS institution_id, regexp_replace(trim(s.treatment_manager), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS raw FROM public.study s WHERE nullif(trim(s.treatment_manager), '') IS NOT NULL AND s.fk_treatment_manager_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LOOP v_person := public.tmp_siamois_person_for_name(r.raw, true, r.institution_id); UPDATE public.study s SET fk_treatment_manager_id = v_person WHERE s.fk_institution_id = r.institution_id AND regexp_replace(trim(s.treatment_manager), '\s+', ' ', 'g') = r.raw; PERFORM public.tmp_siamois_add_awaiting_member(v_person, r.institution_id, s.fk_action_unit_id) FROM public.study s WHERE s.fk_treatment_manager_id = v_person AND s.fk_institution_id = r.institution_id; END LOOP; END $do$;

changeSet.author: Julien Linget
changeSet.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.tmp_siamois_add_awaiting_member(bigint, bigint, bigint); DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.tmp_siamois_person_for_name(text, boolean, bigint);

changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.custom_field SET answer_type = 'SELECT_ONE_PERSON', is_text_area = NULL WHERE custom_field_id IN (-112, -813);
